title: Keep caffeine inside your effective window.
subtitle: Caffeine timing
rationale: Place caffeine where your recorded dose supports work while staying clear of your learned sleep cutoff.

evidence.summary: Caffeine can disrupt sleep even when consumed six hours before bedtime.

indications: Caffeine intake continues within 8 hours of bedtime.
Sleep onset or depth degrades on days with late caffeine.
Total intake is fine but timing drifts late under deadline pressure.
